question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Control
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Control"** means to exercise restraint or direction over; dominate; command. (नियंत्रण)

 
 
• **Example:** The manager needs to **control **the team to achieve the project goals.
 
 
 
• **"Grip"** refers to a firm hold; a tight grasp or clasp. (पकड़)
 
 
• **Example:** She tightened her** grip** on the handle to lift the heavy box.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Control'** is **'Grip'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Embrace** (गले लगाना): To hold someone closely in one's arms, especially as a sign of affection.

 
 
• **Example:** They embraced each other warmly after a long time apart.
 
 
 
• **Fold** (मोड़ना): To bend something flexible and relatively flat over on itself so that one part of it covers another.
 
 
• **Example:** She folded the letter carefully before placing it in the envelope.
 
 
 
• **Purchase** (खरीदना): To acquire something by paying for it; buy.
 
 
• **Example:** He decided to purchase a new laptop for his work.
